rows.title_full: AN ACT TO ACCELERATE THE TECHNOLOGICAL DEVELOPMENT AND MODERNIZATION OF THE PHILIPPINES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE PURPOSE
rows.abstract: "Rapid Technology Development Act of 1993" Provides  for these areas of  concern: (1) State policies directed toward rapid technology development; (2) institution of   the RAPID TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER AND ADAPTATION PROGRAM;  (3) incentives for  firmsproviding services   for technology transfer; (4) establishment of science and technology parks; and (5) incentives for scientists, etc. * * *
rows.status: Substituted by HB11305
